summary: Addressed all 3 code review findings. Fixed @jit decorators with safe wrappers, preserved exception chain, added logger warning, and added subprocess-based tests for the JAX-failure path.

acceptance_criteria_met.F1: 3 new tests (RuntimeError/AttributeError/ImportError) verify import doesn't crash, _require_jax() and GPUBacktestEngine instantiation raise RuntimeError with chain. All pass.
acceptance_criteria_met.F2: _jax_import_error stores exception object; raise RuntimeError(...) from _jax_import_error preserves chain.
acceptance_criteria_met.F3: logger.warning(...) added in except block with type name and message.
acceptance_criteria_met.AC-4: 58 existing tests still pass (working JAX path preserved).
acceptance_criteria_met.AC-5: Importing gpu_engine.py when JAX is broken now truly does not crash (fixed @jit decorator issue uncovered by testing).

out_of_scope_fixes.description: Discovered that @jit decorators at module level crash when jit=None. Fixed by introducing _maybe_jit and _maybe_partial_jit safe wrappers that return fn unchanged when jit is not available.
out_of_scope_fixes.rationale: Required for AC-5 (import must not crash).

notes_for_reviewer: Changed @jit decorators to @_maybe_jit / @_maybe_partial_jit - this was necessary to prevent module-level crash when jit is None
New test file uses subprocess because JAX is installed on this machine
Tests simulate 3 failure modes: RuntimeError, AttributeError, ImportError
No handoff/context files were committed (only code changes)
